articles.title: Twins’ Joe Ryan soaks in atmosphere in final home start of 2026
articles.description: Ryan, who went 0-5 with an 8.49 ERA in his first five games after the All-Star Game, looked to be headed for a rough outing Friday against the Rangers. He allowed the first three batters to reach base ...

articles.title: Astros’ chance to seize AL West doomed by dropped throw, debatable decision
articles.description: With the Rangers losing to the Twins, a win on Friday night would’ve reduced the Astros’ magic number to one. They failed to capitalize.
